description: This Java class provides abstract helper methods for mapping between Adaptable objects and Message objects, including creating messages from Adaptables, extracting headers, and getting status codes. It is part of a protocol adapter for Eclipse Ditto, focusing on message transformation strategies.

classes.name: AbstractMessageMappingStrategies
classes.description: An abstract class providing static helper methods for mapping Adaptables to Messages and extracting message headers and status codes within a Ditto protocol adapter context.

methods.name: messageFrom
methods.description: Creates a Message object from an Adaptable, including deserializing the payload and assembling headers.

methods.name: messageHeadersFrom
methods.description: Generates message headers from an Adaptable by extracting relevant header information and payload metadata.

methods.name: statusCodeFrom
methods.description: Retrieves the HttpStatusCode from an Adaptable's payload, throws NullPointerException if absent.
